gaps.description: The catalogue supplies a traveler visual and scene-event dialogue capability, but no verified actor-placement capability or contract for attaching this stationary traveler to a map scene event. Configure a stationary traveler using the supplied visual and existing dialogue interaction if the authoring system supports that combination; otherwise this encounter's traveler beat cannot be implemented from verified catalogue capabilities alone. No movement is needed.
gaps.neededFor: Showing and speaking with the traveler on Sunlit Trail.

note: Gap reports record authoring work requested by the scene; they do not add capabilities to the catalogue or make the scene playable.
